description.value: In the first longitudinal study comparing the effects of an 8-week meditation training versus relaxation training on affective processing and resting-state connectivity changes among elderly individuals, we found that meditation, but not relaxation, training ‘neutralized’ individuals' perceived valence and decreased the general perceived arousal of affective stimuli.
